{{Top|leg}}
A '''cyberdoc''' was a medical professional specializing in [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]]. They were usually found working out of [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowports]]. Cyberdocs were known to operate out of [[StarForge Station]]<ref name="PW">{{WEGCite|story=Preparing for War|book=The Far Orbit Project}}</ref> and [[Tanquilla Beach/Legends|Tanquilla Beach]].<ref name="SD">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Shintel Downtime|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref>
